description: The tab's previous runs and what changed between each one and the one before it (score delta, findings that appeared and that disappeared). Every run has always been kept; this is where you read the series. Each entry carries the score, the counts and a `change` with the point delta and the findings that appeared (`broke`) or disappeared (`fixed`) since the previous run — compared by finding code, never by message. Runs older than the watch feature are matched by URL.

id.description: ID of the tab whose runs you want.

limit.description: how many runs, newest first (default 20, max 100)

name: tab_history
title: Tab history
